briefing.summary: Being vectored to intercept the localiser. Approach has just issued a turn.

lastTransmission.speaker: atc
lastTransmission.text: Mike X-ray Golf, turn left heading two seven zero, descend to five thousand.

challenge.prompt: Read back the vector and descent.
challenge.expectedText: Left heading two seven zero, descend to five thousand, Mike X-ray Golf.

elements.label: Turn + heading
elements.hint: Include the turn direction and the heading — both are mandatory.

challenge.explanation: MATS Part 4: heading instructions and level changes are mandatory readback items. Always include turn direction with the heading so ATC knows which way you'll roll.
